title: Keep the elapsed search-budget tests passing under whole-suite load on a many-core host
outcome: Keep the elapsed search-budget tests passing under whole-suite load on a many-core host
acceptance: mcp::search::tests::search_does_not_block_other_verbs_on_the_same_mcp_connection, listing::corrections::listing_continuation_metadata_overflow_is_an_explicit_refusal and listing::corrections::listing_continuation_receipt_budget_overflow_is_an_explicit_refusal pass in a whole-library cargo test --lib run on DL560 (CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=48, normal test threads), without loosening what each test asserts

completion.summary: The three search tests no longer depend on the real 10 s budget or a 12 s rescue, so whole-suite load on a many-core host can't fail them that way. First fixed in c7e379a4; final form in landed master 2667355d. They passed in FULL test-1eef162a on DL560 and in four concurrent library copies in test-2f46e868, without any assertion loosened. Self-asserted: evaluation enforcement is off. The criterion's exact configuration, one cargo test --lib run at CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=48 with normal test threads, was not run: the FULL used RUST_TEST_THREADS=36, the margin run was capped, and CARGO_BUILD_JOBS for both is unrecorded here. Closed on that evidence at the coordinator's request, under Greg's direction to stop timing runs.
